title: EARLY EXTERNAL SAFETY TESTING OF OPENAI’S O3-MINI: INSIGHTS FROM PRE-DEPLOYMENT EVALUATION
benchmark_measurement: The paper measures general safety across 14 categories, such as hate speech, discrimination, terrorism, and misinformation. It does not specifically measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
